theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fc_dtop_ip_isometry_change_of_variables
theorems.statement: ∀ (P Q d : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → Euclid Q), Isometry f → MeasurableEmbedding f ∧ (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), Measure.map f ((μHE[d] : Measure (Euclid P)).restrict A) = (μHE[d] : Measure (Euclid Q)).restrict (f '' A)) ∧ (∀ (A : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid Q → ℝ), ∫ y in f '' A, g y ∂μHE[d] = ∫ x in A, g (f x) ∂μHE[d]) ∧ ∀ (A : Set (Euclid P)) (g : Euclid Q → ℝ≥0∞), ∫⁻ y in f '' A, g y ∂μHE[d] = ∫⁻ x in A, g (f x) ∂μHE[d]
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
